content: I push the inn door open. Marin's behind the bar; Hadrik is in the corner booth like last time. I nod to Marin and walk straight to Hadrik's table. Describe both their reactions.
I sit across from Hadrik without asking. 'Marin says you talk to no one. Make an exception.' I keep one eye on Marin behind the bar.
Marin sets two ales on the bar without looking up — the second one is for me, but she's making me come get it. Meanwhile Hadrik hasn't answered.
